candidate.work_authorization: Describe your real work authorization status here -- e.g. country of residence, visa/EOR needs

career_requirements._note: Persistent non-negotiables and preferences. These are filters/preferences the system reads, not assumptions it invents about you. Every field is editable here.

allocation_targets._note: Configurable starting points, not scientifically optimal targets -- adjust freely.

company_preferences.mission_notes: describe what kind of company mission/product you care about

career_requirements.personal_direction: A short paragraph on what you actually want your career to look like.

voice_profile._note: Used by the application-question and paste-sheet generators instead of a hardcoded style. Edit this directly to change how generated answers sound.
voice_profile._writing_samples_note: Add real excerpts of your own writing here (emails, messages, notes) to use as style evidence instead of an invented personality. Empty by default -- nothing is fabricated to fill this in.

experience.title: Example Internship Title
bullets: Describe a real, checkable thing you did -- never invented by the system, always your own words.

projects.name: Example Project
bullets: Describe what it actually does and what you built.

factuality_policy: Never add a skill, employer, degree, metric, certification, job title, location, language level, salary claim or work-authorisation claim unless it exists in this profile or the user explicitly approves the change. Reordering, spelling out abbreviations and truthful reframing are allowed.
